paper.title: ColorFM: An Optimization-to-Learning Framework for Color Transfer via Flow Matching

official_repository.content: README and static image/video assets only

colorfm_o.conditioning: pretrained semantic masks plus corresponding source/style region distributions
colorfm_o.coupling: recursive mean-centred RGB octant partition with random leaf pairing
colorfm_o.operator: two-layer bias-free 512-hidden-unit velocity MLP optimized for 700 steps

colorfm_l.teacher: ColorFM-O outputs from Unsplash and DIV2K content/style pairs
colorfm_l.conditioning: ViT-S/16 deep semantic features and cross-attention
colorfm_l.predicted_parameters: weights of a shared bias-free pixel-wise velocity MLP

reason: semantic-region matching and hierarchical RGB coupling can impose a useful smooth transport prior, but the constructed pairs are not observed correspondences and cannot identify a real digital-to-film operator. The released repository contains no source, checkpoint or license, and the paper velocity MLP plus one-step Euler path does not enforce the project's cube, range, positive-Jacobian, inverse or coefficient bounds
allowed_reuse: implement the published hierarchical colour coupling pseudocode clean-room on synthetic distributions
fit only the validated U5.R2O0 cube-preserving explicit flow from the constructed pairs
compare correct-condition, shuffled-condition, random-pair and distribution-only controls on hidden known operators
retain ColorFM-O as a future generic reference-transfer baseline after independent rights and data gates
forbidden_actions: clone or execute the unlicensed display-only repository as implementation evidence
call hierarchical coupling true pixel pairing or identified transport
use current film pixels, stock labels, source or scanner cues
train ColorFM-L or a direct final-RGB network
use an unconstrained velocity MLP or one-step Euler output as Style-safe RGB
claim stock response, calibration, film authenticity or artifact freedom
interrupt, retune or overwrite the frozen U5.R2S3 or U5.R2S4 experiments
next_candidate: after U5.R2S3 and its conditionally activated U5.R2S4 are adjudicated, a separately frozen synthetic HCC-to-U5.R2O0 recovery control may test whether explicit coupling bias improves hidden-operator recovery
claim_ceiling: paper/source/method audit and clean-room synthetic-control permission only; no reproduction, real-image, film, stock, preference, calibration or unpaired-operator evidence
